title: Backup
description: Full-app export (Phase 3). A plain plan export uses plan.schema.json directly instead of wrapping it here. The plaintext JSON below is what gets passphrase-encrypted (Argon2id-derived AES-256) for the on-disk backup file - encryption wraps this document, it isn't part of its shape.

schema_version.description: Bump on any breaking change; add a migration step per bump. Independent from plan.schema_version - a plan embedded here still carries its own schema_version.

exercises.description: Only custom exercises need to round-trip here; seed-library exercises are reseeded on import rather than duplicated in every backup.

session_logs.description: Phase 2 execution history, needed for full-backup restore (history/PR/progress views) but not part of a single-plan export.

week_number.description: Needed alongside day+session_name to identify which PlanSession this log belongs to - a plan can repeat the same session_name across multiple weeks (e.g. "Push Day" in both week 1 and week 2), so plan_id+session_name alone is ambiguous.

skipped_exercises.description: Optional. Prescribed exercises skipped in this session; absent in backups taken before skip tracking existed.

exercise_name.description: Snapshot at the time of the skip.

notes.description: Optional trainee-to-trainer note on this set.
